costs.metaDescription: What real contributors recorded spending on their New Zealand working holiday — reported figures from published stories, not an estimate or a budget.
costs.title: What a working holiday cost
costs.framing: These are the figures contributors recorded about trips they actually took. They are a record of what happened to those people, not an estimate, a budget, or a prediction for your own trip. What a working holiday costs varies enormously by region, season, and how you travel.
costs.overallHeading: Reported total for a whole trip
costs.perMonthNote: From stories that recorded both trip dates, for trips of at least a month — a total on its own cannot tell a three-month trip from a year.

costs.notEnough: Not enough published stories yet to report {what} honestly. Figures appear once at least five stories cover the same thing.
costs.footerBefore: Every figure here comes from a story you can read in full.
costs.footerAfter: to see the trips behind the numbers — the context is usually the part that matters.

about.title: About Kakinotes
about.p1: Kakinotes shares detailed, written first-person stories from Working Holiday Visa travellers in New Zealand, so future travellers can find accounts relevant to their own plans.
about.p2: Kakinotes is an independent platform. It is not Immigration New Zealand and does not provide immigration, legal, employment, tax, or financial advice — every story is one person's personal experience.
about.p3: A fuller description of the project, its founding contributors, and how stories are reviewed is coming soon.

legal.privacyBody: Our full privacy policy is being finalised. Kakinotes does not collect passport scans, visa or immigration documents, bank credentials, exact live locations, or medical records.
legal.termsBody: Our full terms of use are being finalised. This page is a placeholder.
legal.guidelinesBody: Our full community guidelines are being finalised. In brief: stories must be genuine personal experiences, published with the contributor's permission and rights-cleared images.
legal.copyrightBody: If you believe a published story or image infringes your rights, or you are a contributor who wants a story corrected, withdrawn, or deleted, a reporting and removal process is coming soon. This page is a placeholder.
